review_candidates.description: Siemens is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Define and execute test and quality plans for simulator features and analyses in collaboration with development and marketing teams. Develop, execute, and automate validation test cases using analog design languages such as SPICE and Verilog-A. Monitor, benchmark, and report simulator performance, identifying and investigating performance regressions and optimization opportunities. Design innovative test scenarios and customer-based use cases to maximize feature validation and test coverage. Investigate, reproduce, and diagnose customer-reported issues, ensuring accurate defect reporting and resolution support for development teams. Evaluate products against key quality attributes (FURPS), with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and usability. Measure and improve test coverage, validation methodologies, and overall product quality processes. Collaborate closely with developers and product engineers to qualify new technologies and enhance product capabilities. Self-motivated and inventive, with the ability to work independently with minimal direction. Excellent command of English and strong presentation skills. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. review_candidates.title: Technical Sales Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Sukan Engineering Sukan Engineering Pvt. Ltd. has served Indian industry since 1988. We are a channel partner and authorized distributor for leading global automation and instrumentation principals including Emerson (Rosemount, Fisher, ASCO, Aventics), Danfoss , AUMA and Durag . We supply and support instrumentation, control valves, actuators and allied products for nuclear (NPCIL), thermal and gas power stations, as well as a wide range of process industries across India, working closely with major utilities, PSUs and EPCs. Alongside distribution we run our own applications, proposals and field-service teams, operating from our office in Vadodara. About the role You will own order intake and margin for your territory, selling Sukan's instrumentation, control valve, pneumatics and electric-actuator lines to power stations, process plants, EPCs and OEMs. This is a technical field sales role: you will spend most of your week inside plants and project offices understanding applications, then convert those conversations into specifications, offers and orders with support from our proposals and applications teams. Location and territory: Gandhidham, covering Bhuj/Gandhidham and the assigned territory within Gujarat. The product lines you would represent Depending on your allocated accounts and territory, you would represent one or more of the following lines: ASCO: solenoid valves (SOV / EMV), pilot and directional valves, process valves, NAMUR-mounted valves, and fuel and safety shut-off valves. AVENTICS: pneumatic valves and valve systems, cylinders and actuators, and air-preparation units. Emerson — Measurement Solutions (Rosemount): pressure and differential-pressure transmitters, temperature measurement, flowmeters, level instruments, tank measurement systems, and analytical instrumentation including gas and flame detection. Emerson — Fisher (control valves): sliding-stem and rotary control valves, severe-service valves, pneumatic actuators, positioners, and FIELDVUE digital valve controllers. Emerson — Pressure Management (PRM): pressure-reducing and back-pressure regulators, safety and relief valves, tank blanketing systems, pressure-vacuum relief valves, emergency venting, flame-arresting equipment, and steam and pump protection. AUMA: electric actuators for motor-operated valves (MOV) — multi-turn, part-turn and linear — together with actuator controls, communication systems and gearboxes. You are not expected to know all of this on day one. We are looking for someone who is genuinely strong in at least one of these product streams and has the aptitude and appetite to learn the rest. Expert knowledge of the entire portfolio is not a requirement — depth in one area plus a demonstrated ability to pick up new technology is what we are hiring for. Key responsibilities Achieve the assigned targets for order intake, revenue, gross margin and new-business development in your territory, and report progress accurately every month. Build and execute a territory plan and key-account plans — which accounts, which product streams, which projects, and what has to happen this quarter for the number to land. Acquire new customers while growing repeat and MRO business from the existing base; keep the funnel current and honest in the CRM. Manage the full stakeholder chain — end users, EPC contractors, consultants, OEMs, contractors and system integrators — and understand who specifies, who approves and who buys in each account. Make regular plant visits to identify project, MRO, replacement, retrofit, spares and shutdown opportunities, and convert plant-floor observations into qualified enquiries. Run the RFQ-to-order cycle end to end: capture the requirement and service conditions, get the offer prepared with proposals and applications, present it, handle technical and commercial clarifications, follow up, negotiate within approved limits, and close a clean, executable purchase order. Get Sukan and our principals specified and approved — vendor registrations, approved-vendor listings and specification inclusion with end users, consultants, EPCs and PSUs. Handle post-order coordination — order acknowledgement, document and drawing approvals, delivery follow-up, commercial issue resolution — and support collections and receivables health for your accounts. Maintain market and competitive intelligence for your territory: competitor activity and pricing, upcoming projects and capex plans, and feed it back to the product-line and management team. Travel Frequent travel, typically 10–15 days a month within the assigned territory. This is a field role — extensive travel across the territory is a core part of the job. Working hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer | Data Infrastructure | Rust
review_candidates.description: About BlockTech BlockTech is a fast-paced algorithmic trading firm. Specializing in crypto options, we facilitate global cryptocurrency derivatives and spot trading, while expanding into new markets. As we continue to grow rapidly, we are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to take technical ownership of the data infrastructure our trading and technology teams are built on. Every decision at BlockTech starts with data: exchange feeds, our own trade and account events, and the history we query to make sense of both. The Foundation team owns the systems that move, aggregate, and store all of it. We run our own Kafka, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and Iceberg, self-hosted and tuned by us. We work primarily in Rust, with Python and SQL alongside. This is a role for an engineer who has already built and operated data infrastructure at scale, and who wants their technical decisions to set direction rather than follow it. What will you do? You will own the pipelines and stores every other team depends on. When a researcher backtests a strategy, when a trader checks a position, when risk queries yesterday, they are all reading data your systems ingested, routed, and kept correct. As a senior engineer, you will also set the technical standards the rest of the team builds against. You Will Own the ingest path. Collect public and private exchange information and internal trading data with minimal latency impact, and land it in our trading systems in real time. Architect the streaming layer. Design and operate our Kafka and NATS messaging systems for the throughput and delivery guarantees our critical flows depend on. Build the storage layer. Develop real-time aggregation and long-term storage across PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and Iceberg, and make the structural calls that keep queries fast as volumes grow. Run what you build. Own capacity, retention, schema evolution, and failure behavior for infrastructure we host ourselves, with no managed service to hide behind. Make the data trustworthy. Design the detection and repair flows that catch gaps, duplicates, and drift, and correct them before anyone downstream notices. Enable other teams. Work with trading, quantitative research, and engineering to make integrating with our platform straightforward, and turn recurring problems into shared libraries and frameworks. Drive projects end to end. Take work from concept to production with full ownership, and bring in new tools and approaches when the current ones stop being the right answer. Raise the bar. Mentor engineers, lead by example in code and design reviews, and influence the technical direction of the wider team. Essential What we're looking for 5+ years as a software engineer, including a track record of designing and operating production data infrastructure where reliability and correctness are non-negotiable. Proficiency in Rust, or strong C/C++ with the appetite to work primarily in Rust. Hands-on experience with the infrastructure we rely on: Kafka, Redpanda, NATS, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, and/or Iceberg. Ideally self-hosted rather than through managed or cloud services. Solid understanding of distributed systems, with the judgment to reason about consistency, backpressure, and failure modes. Systems-level thinking, including a feel for where hardware constraints start to matter. A very strong sense of end-to-end ownership, and a critical mind that follows problems through to completion. Good written and verbal communication skills in English. Bonus Points For A background in trading, fintech, or another domain where bad data has immediate consequences. Experience with observability tooling such as Grafana. Familiarity with WebSockets, compiler engineering, or systems security. How We Work This is an on-site role in our Amsterdam office, built around a high degree of autonomy and end-to-end ownership. You will have hard problems to own from concept through to production, and the freedom to solve them your way. It is a strong fit for people who are energized by deep technical challenges, a wide variety of technologies, and a high level of responsibility. What's in it for you? A full-time position in a relaxed and modern office in Amsterdam Competitive compensation consisting of a base salary combined with a very attractive bonus plan based on individual and company performance Outstanding performance is rewarded with the opportunity to buy into the trading fund Pension plan, company laptop, and reimbursement of your internet costs at home An extensive in-house training program and an annual learning & development budget The opportunity to work at the forefront of automated trading using technology built for speed and precision, in an environment that embraces AI to both accelerate productivity and advance our systems and models Gym membership reimbursement and the opportunity to engage in various sports during working hours, including kickboxing, CrossFit, fitness, and soccer Regular social events, including weekly Friday drinks, monthly outings, quarterly sports competitions, and bi-annual trips abroad Daily breakfast and warm lunch, plus snacks and drinks throughout the day For internationals: an all-in relocation package and Dutch classes Our culture At our core, we are a team of passionate trading and tech enthusiasts committed to revolutionizing trading through automation. Our collaborative approach ensures that everyone contributes to achieving our ambitious goals. In this role, you will be both challenged and stretched, with ample opportunities for growth and development, both within and beyond your main responsibilities. We invest in our people by offering competitive compensation and benefits, fostering innovation, and celebrating success. Our commitment to personal development transcends traditional norms; we provide an equal playing field, promote reverse leadership, and offer boundless growth opportunities for all our employees. Join us to unlock your potential and drive innovation in the exciting world of algorithmic trading.

review_candidates.description: At ISISPACE, we don’t just build satellites—we also operate them. Our inhouse Ground Segment (GS) handles everything from user interfaces for commanding and telemetry to low-level satellite packet processing. As part of the GS-software development team, you’ll take ownership of existing and new projects, driving the evolution of our Mission Control Software suite. The MCS automates satellite operations and controls our next-generation satellites. Your responsibilities will include making architecture decisions, leading design and development, managing the product roadmap, and providing user support. You’ll ensure value for both internal and external users by translating needs into clear requirements, designing practical solutions, and developing robust architectures and software implementations. You’ll approach problem-solving holistically, prioritize effectively, and understand that success requires iteration. Additionally, you’ll provide technical coaching to the GS-software team and advise management on technical developments and needs. Specific tasks and responsibilities include: Own the ground segment software technical roadmap, aligning it with company goals and ensuring its feasibility and success. Take charge of the ground segment software architecture and lead its development in line with the roadmap. Design and develop extensions and new applications, and maintain existing software in collaboration with the development team and users (internal/external). Evaluate and select suitable technologies, perform trade-offs, and propose design changes. Provide technical coaching to the Ground Segment software team. Conduct code and design reviews. Master’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a comparable field. 6+ years in designing and developing software systems. Domain Knowledge: Experience with (operational) ground segment software systems. Technical Skills: Expertise in Python and/or C++. Project Leadership: Proven experience leading software projects through the full project lifecycle. Architecture: Experience with distributed software architectures (service-based, microservices). DevOps: Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD and deployment strategies. Communication: Proactive, clear, and open communication in English. Work Style: Comfortable working independently and in small teams. Security: Eligibility for Dutch security clearance. Bonus points if you bring: Experience with designing and developing full-stack applications. Experience with projects in the defence or security domain. Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ). Experience with Docker.

Present in more than 150 countries, Deloitte is distinct in its ability to help clients solve their most complex problems, from strategy to implementation. Deloitte innovation hub (DIH) is a strategic initiative established to support our ambition to become the leading business transformation partner of choice for our clients and to expand and scale our delivery footprint across EMEA. With access to a scaled, diverse, highly skilled, motivated, and engaged workforce, DIH is delivering complex technical solutions for clients’ most complex business problems, across portfolios that include ‘Strategy & Transactions’, ‘Customer’, ‘Engineering, AI & Data, ‘Enterprise, Technology & Performance’ and ‘Cyber’. DIH is aiming to become the destination for top talents in Egypt for a long, exciting career. We invest in outstanding people of diverse talents and backgrounds and empower them to achieve more than they could elsewhere. Our work combines advice with action and integrity. We believe that when our clients and society are stronger, so are we. Our organization has grown in scale and diversity, providing services across the region, with our shared culture remaining the same. We aim to help clients realize their ambitions, make a positive difference in society, and maximize the success of our people. This drive fuels the commitment and humanity that run deep through our every action. Connect to your opportunity. This role is for a skilled and adaptable Frontend developer to join a fast-paced development effort to re-architect and modernize digital platforms. As a core member of our development team, you will design, develop, and modify custom software solutions that solve problems, improve business operations, and manage the complexity inherent in technology change. Design, develop and modify frontend systems and custom components using a modern dev stack. Develop software solutions by analysing system performance standards, confer with users or system engineers; analyse systems flow, data usage, and work processes; and investigate problem areas. Integrate existing software into new or modified systems. Develop and execute test procedures for software components. Analyse user requirements to derive technical software design and performance requirements. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters. Personal independence Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to several audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints. This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm. The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process. Connect to your Industry “What attracted me to Deloitte were the endless opportunities and the collective experience of other like-minded individuals. Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead. Connect to your next step A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
